.octos/KNOWLEDGE-DIGEST.md: - U10.1 tool repair: board_run stops remaining shards on every nonzero result (including completed-app rc1), always runs before_unlock and retains lock on recovery failure. Missing HDC status markers retry only literal read commands (3 attempts/original timeout); uncertain writes are never replayed and enter transactional fail-safe.
.octos/OPS-RUNBOOK.md: - U10.1 supplemental windows: any shard rc!=0 ends that board window and goes directly to finish; never run the next manifest after cleanup refusal. Treat untouched keys as unknown. HDC marker retry is read-only and bounded; do not manually replay a lost-response write. Keep the lock until rollback+318+recovery smoke+final pass.
